controlPlane.purpose: Binding privacy control-plane contract for URAI product, admin, analytics, communications, media, spatial, foundation, B2B, and asset-generation systems.

systems.role: core user experience and primary user data collection surface

requiredAdoption.consent: must read consentRecords before optional personalization, analytics, messaging, or data-sharing behavior
requiredAdoption.export: must contribute user-owned account, profile, activity, and preference data to export manifests
requiredAdoption.deletion: must register user-owned account/profile/activity deletion targets and retention exceptions
requiredAdoption.retention: must respect active retention policy records and produce retention evidence
requiredAdoption.audit: must write privacy-relevant user/admin access events to auditLogs or privacyEvidence
requiredAdoption.adminAccess: must rely on custom claims or verified admin role documents, never client-only admin UI checks
requiredAdoption.dataMinimization: must avoid storing optional personalization data when consent is absent
requiredAdoption.incidentResponse: must surface privacy-impacting incidents to the shared evidence log

systems.role: production user-facing deployment and live app runtime

requiredAdoption.consent: must gate live runtime tracking and optional personalization on consentRecords
requiredAdoption.export: must expose live production user data to export job assembly
requiredAdoption.deletion: must honor deletionRequests with auditable destructive/non-destructive modes
requiredAdoption.retention: must enforce production retention policy and record exceptions
requiredAdoption.audit: must write live privacy events to auditLogs
requiredAdoption.adminAccess: must require verified admin authority for production privacy/admin actions
requiredAdoption.dataMinimization: must not emit optional telemetry without consent
requiredAdoption.incidentResponse: must record production privacy incidents and rollback evidence

systems.role: admin operations, privacy request queues, and privileged access workflows

requiredAdoption.consent: must not override user consent without auditable legal/admin basis
requiredAdoption.export: must expose request status and export job review without leaking private export objects
requiredAdoption.deletion: must require explicit admin authorization and notes for destructive operations
requiredAdoption.retention: must display retention exceptions and legal hold state
requiredAdoption.audit: must write adminActions and auditLogs for every sensitive operation
requiredAdoption.adminAccess: must enforce verified admin custom claims/role documents server-side
requiredAdoption.dataMinimization: must avoid unnecessary replication of sensitive user data into admin views
requiredAdoption.incidentResponse: must record incident owner, timeline, and corrective actions

requiredAdoption.consent: must filter analytics ingestion and segmentation by consentRecords
requiredAdoption.export: must contribute user-level analytics events when retained and permitted
requiredAdoption.deletion: must delete or anonymize user-level analytics records on deletionRequests
requiredAdoption.audit: must record analytics access, export, deletion, and anonymization evidence
requiredAdoption.adminAccess: must restrict segment/user drilldown to verified roles
requiredAdoption.dataMinimization: must prefer aggregates and anonymized records over raw user events
requiredAdoption.incidentResponse: must record analytics data exposure or re-identification risks

systems.role: notification, email, SMS, and outbound communication workflows

requiredAdoption.consent: must gate marketing, notification, SMS, and email categories on consentRecords
requiredAdoption.export: must include retained communication preferences and message logs in exports
requiredAdoption.deletion: must delete or suppress user communication records according to deletionRequests
requiredAdoption.retention: must retain only required transactional evidence and documented exceptions
requiredAdoption.audit: must record consent changes, message category changes, and suppression actions
requiredAdoption.adminAccess: must restrict manual outreach and override actions to verified admins
requiredAdoption.dataMinimization: must avoid unnecessary copies of email/phone/contact metadata
requiredAdoption.incidentResponse: must log mis-send, suppression failure, or contact-data incident evidence

systems.role: creative studio, media/story asset workflows, and user-generated content surfaces

requiredAdoption.consent: must gate reuse/training/sharing of media and story assets on consentRecords
requiredAdoption.export: must contribute user-owned media/story metadata and retained generated assets
requiredAdoption.deletion: must delete or de-reference user-owned media/story assets when authorized
requiredAdoption.retention: must document retention exceptions for published, licensed, or legally retained assets
requiredAdoption.audit: must record generation, publication, export, deletion, and admin access evidence
requiredAdoption.adminAccess: must restrict moderation and asset recovery to verified roles
requiredAdoption.dataMinimization: must avoid embedding unnecessary personal data in generated metadata
requiredAdoption.incidentResponse: must record media leakage, rights conflict, or deletion failure evidence

systems.role: spatial, AR/VR, location-adjacent, and immersive environment workflows

requiredAdoption.consent: must gate spatial telemetry, personalization, and location-adjacent capture on consentRecords
requiredAdoption.export: must contribute retained user spatial session data and preferences
requiredAdoption.deletion: must delete or anonymize user spatial traces and scene-linked user records
requiredAdoption.retention: must enforce shorter retention for sensitive spatial/location-adjacent data
requiredAdoption.audit: must record spatial data access, export, deletion, and admin actions
requiredAdoption.adminAccess: must restrict scene/user inspection to verified roles
requiredAdoption.dataMinimization: must store derived/minimized spatial data whenever possible
requiredAdoption.incidentResponse: must record exposure of spatial/location-adjacent signals

systems.role: research, public-good, governance, and foundation programs

requiredAdoption.consent: must separate research/public-good consent from product consent
requiredAdoption.export: must include user-linked research participation records when retained
requiredAdoption.deletion: must honor deletion or de-identification requests subject to approved exceptions
requiredAdoption.retention: must document research/legal retention exceptions and approvals
requiredAdoption.audit: must record governance, research data access, export, and deletion evidence
requiredAdoption.adminAccess: must restrict research/admin records to verified authorized roles
requiredAdoption.dataMinimization: must prefer de-identified or aggregate research records
requiredAdoption.incidentResponse: must record research or governance privacy incidents

systems.role: tenant, business customer, and organization-facing workflows

requiredAdoption.consent: must distinguish individual user privacy choices from tenant/business processing basis
requiredAdoption.export: must support user and tenant-scoped export evidence without cross-tenant leakage
requiredAdoption.deletion: must enforce user deletion and tenant retention/legal exceptions
requiredAdoption.retention: must document tenant contractual retention and legal hold rules
requiredAdoption.audit: must record tenant admin access, privacy request handling, and cross-tenant boundaries
requiredAdoption.adminAccess: must enforce tenant admin and URAI admin roles server-side
requiredAdoption.dataMinimization: must avoid duplicating personal data across tenant/support systems

systems.role: generated asset pipeline and asset production workflows

requiredAdoption.consent: must gate use of user-linked prompts/assets for reuse, training, sharing, or promotion
requiredAdoption.export: must contribute retained user-linked prompts, generated assets, and metadata
requiredAdoption.deletion: must delete or de-reference user-linked generated assets when authorized
requiredAdoption.retention: must document licensed/published asset retention exceptions
requiredAdoption.audit: must record generation, publication, export, deletion, and admin access events
requiredAdoption.adminAccess: must restrict asset recovery/moderation to verified roles
requiredAdoption.dataMinimization: must strip unnecessary personal data from prompts and asset metadata
requiredAdoption.incidentResponse: must record prompt leakage, asset rights conflict, or deletion failure evidence
